breadcrumbs.name: Eu Compliance RFID Solutions — NFC Tags For Digital Product Passport & Espr Mandates

summary: The EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) mandates Digital Product Passports starting 2027. NFC tags serve as the physical data carrier on products — storing a unique identifier that links to material composition, carbon footprint, recyclability and supply chain data. Proud Tek provides DPP-ready NFC tags for batteries, textiles, electronics and all regulated product categories.
